name: QuikTrip
verdict: QuikTrip Corporation, a privately held convenience-store chain based in Tulsa, majority-owned by the Cadieux family. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: none (maintainer decision, 1 Oct 2026, #945). Privately held US company, majority-owned by the Cadieux family per Forbes (quiktrip-cadieux-ownership); no state or state fund in the ownership chain. A 2010 DOJ consent decree over store accessibility (United States v. QuikTrip Corporation, D. Neb., 8:10-cv-262) says it isn't an admission of liability, so it isn't a finding under METHOD.md. Previous rating removed 2026-09-25: its only claim was an invented ownership record (#279); replaced with a checked claim.
